name: Lumen Dynamics Prism Goggles
description:
Multi-spectrum goggles with interchangeable lens modules that cycle between thermal, low-light, UV, and standard visible modes. The frame is impact-resistant polymer with an adjustable elastic headband. Each lens module slots into the frame magnetically and can be swapped in under two seconds.

Originally developed for Synthesis Collective research teams working in unstable substrate environments, the Prism goggles found a second market among Shelf scavengers and tunnel crews who work in conditions where standard vision is useless.
functionality: Thermal vision, low-light amplification, UV detection, modular lens swap
what_it_says: You operate in places where visible light is the least useful part of the spectrum.
story_hooks: A scavenger crew using Prism goggles in an abandoned sub-level reports seeing thermal signatures in a section that's been sealed for six years.
related_entities: SynapTech Prism AR Personal Neural Interface
Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Galvanic Resuscitation Frame — 'The Pallbearer's Daughter'

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek, angular goggles with a pronounced horizontal profile. The frame sits flush against the face with a slight forward cant. Large, slightly convex lens apertures dominate the front. An elastic retention band wraps around the back of the head. Overall impression: high-tech utility with minimalist aesthetic.
physical_description.fit: Snug against eye sockets with firm but not restrictive pressure from the elastic band. Sits slightly proud of the face to accommodate lens module depth. Adjustable tension allows for wear over hair, synthetic scalp plating, or neural interface ports.
physical_description.primary_material: Impact-resistant polymer frame (likely carbon-reinforced synthetic composite) with magnetic coupling points. Lens modules are tempered optical polymer with specialized coatings for spectral filtering.
physical_description.texture: Frame has a matte, slightly textured surface with micro-grip ridges for stability during sweat or moisture exposure. Lens surfaces are smooth with subtle anti-reflective rainbow sheen visible under light. Magnetic coupling points have precision-machined feel.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte gunmetal gray frame with black accent ridges around lens apertures. Lens modules ship in deep amber (thermal default), midnight blue (low-light), violet-tinted (UV), and clear (visible). Frame may show light scratching from field use.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap-coupling lens modules (tool-free, two-second swap). Friction-fit elastic headband with no hardware—tension adjusted by band elasticity alone. No straps, no buckles.
distinctive_features: Four interchangeable lens module slots (two per eye, stacked)
Visible magnetic coupling pins with haptic feedback click
Micro-ventilation ports along frame sides to prevent lens fogging
Integrated light-diffusion panel on underside to block peripheral light leakage
Lumen Dynamics logo embossed on left temple (minimalist geometric Φ variant)
Serialized module tracking etched on frame (links to corporate registration system)
Wear patterns typically include scuff marks on lower frame edge from equipment contact
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 transition. Premium enough for corporate research or high-end scavenging operations, but practical enough for working-class tunnel crews. Price point excludes Tier 5, yet the secondary market (Shelf salvage) puts used units in Tier 4 hands regularly.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals either Synthesis Collective affiliation, environmental research credentials, or street-level danger work (tunnel running, substrate scavenging). Worn by people who operate in conditions where standard human vision fails—underground, extreme temperature, contaminated environments. Marks wearer as either credentialed technical worker or capable street operator.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically broken-in with visible micro-scratches on frame and lens surfaces. Elastic band may show slight discoloration from sweat or substrate dust. Lens modules often mismatched (user has preferred pair, carries backup). Frame retains structural integrity even when weathered; these are built to last.

Large lens apertures dominate the frame, with visible magnetic coupling points gleaming under a sharp sidelight. Background is a dark brutalist concrete tunnel wall with faint bioluminescent moss growing in cracks. Secondary deep amber and violet-tinted lens modules lay on a reflective metal surface beside the mannequin. Neon Lumen Dynamics branding glows faintly in the shadows.
